purpose: Small local development adaptation diagnostic; no confirmation, population, causal, or paper-replication claim

model.selection_rule: Use existing final 52-microstep adapter only, chosen for availability before this comparison; no checkpoint search or best-of-result substitution. Abort if its hashes differ.

training_exposure.interpretation: Hardware pilot, substantially less than one epoch; not a full-trained model.

matched_properties: inference precision and MLX package lock
prompt bytes within each arm and evidence condition
model.adapter_application: Fresh sequential processes: base without adapter, same model with adapter; no fused/requantized replacement.

data.unique_people: Audit coordinator reports 116 distinct supplied worker IDs in train and 16 in validation, with zero cross-split supplied-ID/group/topic overlap. Supplied IDs do not prove unique real-world identities.
data.selection_rule: All four successfully prepared validation groups; no outcome-based selection or replacement.
data.split_gate: Verify bound participant-audit.json before execution. No supplied-ID/group/topic overlap; supplied IDs do not establish unique real-world identities and development is not confirmation.
data.reserve_policy: Never enumerate, read, or admit evaluation-reserve payloads. Use prepared development manifest and admitted input files only.
data.researcher_exposure: Pilot already evaluated eight validation batches at iterations 1 and 52. All validation permanently remains development; prior OpenRouter four-person diagnostic selected a training group and is excluded here.

stages.input: Exact preflight-valid.jsonl messages; observed human history preceding each message only.
stages.endpoint: Completion-only negative log likelihood in nats/token using verified prompt-prefix mask including existing EOS convention.
aggregation: overall token-weighted NLL with numerator and supervised token denominator
equal-group mean of within-group per-message means
paired per-group adapter minus base differences
stages.selection: No subset and no checkpoint tuning; record all 133 paired scores.
stages.meaning: Measures transfer on the trained message task; improvement cannot establish private-belief improvement.
stages.primary_endpoint: Overall token-weighted completion-only NLL, paired adapter minus base, across all133 messages.
stages.secondary_endpoint: Equal-group mean of per-message token-mean NLL, plus all four paired group effects.

stages.enabled_when: Integrity gates, local inference runner, immutable prompts, final-target isolation, probability parser smoke, and resource checks pass.

schedule.history: Initial profile only; no later observed or generated messages.

arms_definition.direct: Initial profile only; one final belief probability vector.

stages.budget_matching: One final call per model/person with identical prompt and limits.
stages.prediction_policy: Seal all32 direct predictions before target scoring. Compare paired adapter-minus-base normalized RPS and record every group outcome. No prompt/checkpoint tuning on these groups.

stages.enabled_when: B1 completes at full coverage and adapter_direct minus base_direct RPS <=0.02; review all per-group effects and integrity records before execution without tuning on these groups. NLL improvement alone does not permit progression or behavioral claims.

schedule.delivery: Synchronous per pass; all outgoing messages complete before peer delivery.
schedule.contact_graph: Recorded round partners, explicitly treated as known metadata; no actual later human messages.
schedule.label: Compressed autonomous-message schedule, not full human conversation replay.

arms_definition.private: Six private reflection messages followed by final belief; never receives peer messages.
arms_definition.swarm: Six messages with round partner delivery followed by final belief; only permitted generated incoming messages.

stages.budget_matching: Private and swarm match generation counts and per-call limits. Their realized input token counts differ; report prompt/output tokens and wall time separately. Direct has fewer calls.
stages.prediction_policy: Seal all B2 predictions before scoring. Retain frozen B1 results for direct contrasts; no B1 reruns or checkpoint substitution.

endpoint_contract.primary_behavior_endpoint: Equal-group mean normalized six-category ranked probability score (RPS); lower better.
endpoint_contract.rps_definition: For each person, mean over k=1..5 of (cumulative predicted probability through k - indicator(final_category <= k)) squared. Average people within group, then groups equally.
endpoint_contract.primary_contrast: pilot_adapter_direct minus base_direct; negative indicates improvement.
behavior_guards: group mean absolute pairwise expected-category distance, explicitly not actual human-response variance
endpoint_contract.no_stance_claim: Do not use generated message stance as private-belief ground truth or unvalidated judge agreement as human fidelity.
baselines: Laplace-one conditional final-given-initial transition matrix fitted only on admitted training groups after participant-overlap gate
endpoint_contract.baseline_fitting: Exclude validation people/groups/topics; seal fitted 6x6 probabilities before validation scoring. No validation tuning.
endpoint_contract.uncertainty: Four groups/topics are too few for a powered claim. Report all paired group effects, coverage and descriptive means. No equivalence or general superiority claim; repeated seeds would not increase independent people.

engineering_progression_rules.status: Proposed practical engineering thresholds, not empirically justified scientific effect sizes or power calculations.
engineering_progression_rules.message_signal: Adapter overall token-weighted completion-only NLL below base; report equal-group secondary and all group effects. This does not substitute for behavioral gate.
engineering_progression_rules.behavioral_signal: Primary contrast <= -0.02 normalized RPS and adapted direct RPS <= best declared baseline RPS.
engineering_progression_rules.guards: No validation group worsens by >0.05 RPS; change-event Brier no worse than base direct by >0.02.
engineering_progression_rules.interaction_expansion: Adapter swarm improves over adapter direct by >=0.02 RPS and is no worse than adapter private, with same group/change guards; otherwise defer interaction expansion.
engineering_progression_rules.interpretation: Any passed gate permits more development only. Failed/mixed results are logged; insufficient data remain inconclusive.
engineering_progression_rules.B2_entry_guard: B1 primary RPS difference <=0.02; this engineering non-worsening guard allows further diagnostic work only, not equivalence or success. Review all group outcomes without changing candidate/prompt.

inference.context_policy: No silent truncation. If any planned prompt plus maximum output exceeds cap, stop before running that stage and revise the whole schedule under a new version.
inference.format_policy: Strict six finite nonnegative probabilities <=1, sum within 1e-6 of 1; no repair, renormalization, or retry in this diagnostic. Invalid outputs retained; stop behavioral stage, report coverage; no selectively complete-case headline comparison.
inference.repeat_policy: One deterministic greedy pass; adapter dropout disabled at inference. No selecting best repeats. Any deterministic-repeat diagnostic must retain and report all outputs.

resource_caps.stop_on: Any cap, nonfinite loss, missing target, identity mismatch, model/data hash mismatch, mask mismatch or forbidden input; retain partial artifacts, do not claim completed comparison.
resource_caps.memory_note: Conservative engineering process limits, not guaranteed physical bounds. Record baseline swap and peak RSS/MLX allocation; parent watchdog required for timely termination.

future_training_rule.status: Not authorized or launched by this document. Separate frozen training contract required.
future_training_rule.proposal: One fixed seed and final checkpoint after a predeclared exact optimizer-update budget measured by the instrumented smoke; no best-validation checkpoint search. Set budget before training from measured time/memory, record all attempts, and run this comparison as a new version.
future_training_rule.context: Retain all initial anchors and supervised completion tokens; do not lower context cap below measured token lengths without explicit exclusion audit.

provenance_required: per-case token counts and completion masks
all predictions, failures, exclusions and seals
explicit native-host/offline boundary without Docker isolation claim
implementation_blockers: Current scripts/run_debate_development_test.py is OpenRouter-only, picks a training group, and cannot execute this matched local contract unchanged.
No matching local completion-NLL and six-arm inference runner verified yet.
Verify bound participant-overlap audit before execution; no independent-holdout claim.
Frozen prompt and runner hashes must be added to sealed run contract before execution.
Instrumented memory watchdog and full-coverage strict-format smoke required.
Observed-history final-belief protocol needs separately audited receipts and cutoff; not silently merged into autonomous scores.
Upstream MLX lora.run ignores supplied training callback; instrument direct train_model entrypoint to prove memory/swap guards. A final peak-only probe does not validate live watchdog enforcement.
